fusions.name: Skipping Clod
fusions.desc: Skims a flat clod that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then skips to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each skip dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Burst Dyke
fusions.desc: Cuts through the bank and floods a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 26 water damage that ignores resistances to everything in it and leaving each enemy [Soaked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Heads Down
fusions.desc: You drop into a dug hole: for 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Runs Off Downhill
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it.
